name: Jagged Cheek Gash
description: A thick, raised crimson ridge stretching diagonally across your left cheek. It gives you the hardened look of a seasoned vanguard.
freshEffect: Tender, throbbing tissue. -1 Charisma.

name: Shattered Left Ear
description: A portion of your upper ear cartilage was torn or hacked off in a close-quarters struggle. It throbs faintly when frost sets in.
freshEffect: Constant ringing and disorientation. -1 Defense.

name: Crushed Collarbone Ridge
description: A crooked, calcified bump where your clavicle snapped and mended slightly misaligned. Creaks under heavy physical stress.
freshEffect: Pain when carrying weight or pulling bows. -1 Strength.
healedEffect: Calcified and reinforced bone structure. +1 Defense.

name: Tundra Frostbite Patches
description: A patch of dull, insensitive skin across your right shoulder from exposure or exposure to magical ice. Faint and numb.
freshEffect: Poor circulation and numbing chills. -2 Max HP.
healedEffect: Hardened skin acclimated to cold. +5 Max HP.

name: Sovereign Rift Singe Mark
description: A swirling spiral of darkened, purple scorched skin left behind by spatial rifts or void magic. Faintly hums beneath the starlight.
freshEffect: Void whispers in your mind. -1 Intelligence.

name: Beast Fang Puncture
description: Four deep, circular scar rings on your forearm from a savage teeth sink. The skin around them is thick, pale, and tight.
freshEffect: Stiffness and forearm muscle spasms. -1 Dexterity.

name: Jagged Abdominal Gash
description: A long, silver-white line of scar tissue crossing your stomach. You can feel the muscle tension tighten when pulling heavy bows.
freshEffect: Unstable core; heavy breathing hurts. -3 Max HP.

name: Searing Acid Splash
description: A mottled, textured pattern of pale skin running down your neck, resembling a frozen liquid splash. Restores memories of green vapor.
freshEffect: Mottled acid burns weep. -1 Charisma.

name: Shadow Mark of the Void
description: An ink-dark, starburst-like imprint on your chest over your heart. Fades to deep blue when nearby dark or hostile anomalies approach.
freshEffect: Abyssal pull drains your soul. -2 Max MP, -1 Luck.

name: Blind Right Eye (Leathery Patch)
description: A brutal strike permanently clouded your right eye, which you now keep covered with a weathered leather patch. (Will restrict future FOV).
freshEffect: Terrible depth perception and vertigo. -2 Dexterity.

name: Obsidian Shard Fragment
description: A dark, glass-sharp sliver of obsidian remained embedded deep near your collarbone. Extricating it is too dangerous; it glints slightly.
freshEffect: Sliver grinds painfully with arm movement. -1 Strength, -1 Dexterity.

name: Grizzled Eyebrow Split
description: A clean vertical part in your left eyebrow where a dagger tip grazed too close. It adds a permanently focused, rogueish glint to your eyes.
freshEffect: Tender skin under eyebrow. -1 Charisma.

name: Wyrm Breath Vapor Burn
description: A patch of iridescent, shimmering heat scales across your shoulder blade, memento of an encounter with extreme mystical flames.
freshEffect: Severe blistering and heat sensitivity. -4 Max HP.
healedEffect: Dragon-scale dermal insulation. +1 Defense, +6 Max HP.

name: Spectral Lich Shiver Curse
description: A pale, perpetually chilled scar ring around your wrist. It leaves the skin icy to the touch and slightly clouds nearby light.
freshEffect: Bone-chilling cold drains mana pathways. -3 Max MP.

name: Heart of the Abyss Seal
description: A blazing, star-shaped brand over your breastbone, earned by descending deep into the roots of Sunder. Pulsates with void power.
freshEffect: Void madness clouds premonitions. -2 Luck.

name: Celestial Crest Alignment
description: A brilliant, faint golden seal that burned itself onto your hand during a legendary duel. Glows with a celestial warmth.
freshEffect: Golden skin is raw and tender. -1 Attack.

name: Rusty Trap Bolt Gash
description: A jagged horizontal slash across your thigh from a rusty spring-trap. It still aches when storm clouds brew.
freshEffect: Limping and slow movement reflexes. -1 Dexterity.

name: Gilded Ghoul Bite
description: A double-crescent puncture mark from a high-tier dungeon ghoul. The wound mended into an ash-grey circular scar.
freshEffect: Necrotic fever and muscle fatigue. -2 Max HP, -1 Strength.
healedEffect: Marrow toxin resistance. +5 Max HP, +1 Luck.

name: Shattered Ribcage Dent
description: A deep hollow in your lower ribs from a crushing warhammer blow. The bones fused into a steel-like calcified defense.
freshEffect: Severely restricted shallow breathing. -4 Max HP, -1 Strength.

name: Basilisk Gaze Calcification
description: A hardened, grey scales patch over your forearm left by petrifying vapors. It is heavy but dense.
freshEffect: Flesh is heavy, sluggish, and grey. -2 Dexterity, -1 Strength.

name: Deep Swamp Rot Blisters
description: Irregular circular scars from navigating caustic swamp waters in Sunder. The skin has mended into thick calluses.
freshEffect: Oozing raw blisters and burning skin. -2 Max HP.

name: Iron Maiden Spike Scar
description: A row of small, round scar dimples on your shoulders from surviving an iron torture cage. It hardened your resolve.
freshEffect: Wounds bleed lightly with action. -3 Max HP.

name: Kraken Harpoon Scrape
description: A spiral, corded rope scar around your left arm, a reminder of grappling with leviathans.
freshEffect: Heavy rope burn restricts swings. -1 Dexterity, -1 Attack.

name: Cursed Executioner's Rope Mark
description: A dark, bruised necklace-like scar from escaping a bandit hangman. Surviving it made you incredibly lucky.
freshEffect: Coughing and tracheal swelling. -3 Max HP, -2 Max MP.
